query:
update users
                set
                    display_name = $1,
                    email = LOWER($2),
                    email_verified= $3,
                    password_hash = $4,
                    totp_secret = $5,
                    totp_recovery_secret = $6,
                    totp_recovery_codes = $7,
                    updated_at = now()
            where id = $8
